detail.longDescription: I have a tar.gz (compressed size: 380MiB, uncompressed size: 5.8GiB) file which has many entries inside of it. I need to get a particular entry (entry size: 5.79GiB) from this archive. Since I was using the default features of flate2 crate which defaults to miniz_oxide , I thought of switching the back-end to zlib-rs , to get better performance. Surprisingly the performance of miniz_oxide back-end was almost twice that of zlib-rs back-end. Am I doing something wrong here? main.rs : use anyhow::{Result, bail}; use flate2::read::GzDecoder; use std::ffi::OsStr; use std::fs::File; use std::io::{Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write}; use std::path::Path; use std::time::Instant; use tar::{Archive, Entry}; fn get_archive(archive_path: &Path) -> Archive<Box<dyn Read>> { println!("{}", module_path!()); let file = File::open(archive_path).expect(&format!("Failed to open archive {archive_path:?}")); Archive::new(Box::new(GzDecoder::new(file))) } fn get_entry<'a, R: Read>( archive: &'a mut Archive<R>, entry_name: &'a str, ) -> Result<Entry<'a, R>> { println!("{}", module_path!()); for entry in archive.entries()? { let entry = entry?; if entry .path() .as_ref() .ok() .and_then(|path| path.file_name()) .and_then(OsStr::to_str) .map(|name| name == entry_name) .unwrap_or(false) { return Ok(entry); } } bail!("Entry '{entry_name}' not found in archive"); } fn main() { let instant = Instant::now(); let mut archive = get_archive(Path::new("archive.tar.gz")); println!("get_archive elapsed duration: {:?}", instant.elapsed()); let mut entry = get_entry(&mut archive, "./entryA"); println!("get_entry elapsed duration: {:?}", instant.elapsed()); } Cargo.toml : [package] name = "flate2_demo" version = "0.1.0" edition = "2024" [dependencies] anyhow = "1.0.104" flate2 = { version = "1.1.11", default-features = false, features = ["zlib-rs", "runtime_detection"] } # flate2 = { version = "1.1.11" } tar = "0.4.46" Performance with miniz_oxide : flate2_demo get_archive elapsed duration: 206.498µs flate2_demo get_entry elapsed duration: 16.96826981s Performance with zlib-rs : flate2_demo get_archive elapsed duration: 102.607µs flate2_demo get_entry elapsed duration: 33.138560864s
